articles.summary: Today we’re announcing Seam Components! Components are a suite of pre-built UI elements to rapidly and effortlessly add advanced device management UI into your products.
articles.title: Introducing Seam Components

articles.summary: Seam is excited to release our official Wyze Integration! You can now connect and control Wyze locks to create access codes for temporary or permanent access.
articles.title: Wyze Integration

articles.summary: Developers, developers, developers! Today we are releasing a beta version of our official C# SDK!
articles.title: Hello C# SDK!

articles.summary: Today, we’re excited to announce our brand new Honeywell Thermostat integration. You can control Honeywell thermostats, along with Nest and Ecobee using a single API to set climates, change mode, and more!
articles.title: New Integration: Honeywell Resideo Thermostats

articles.summary: Seam is excited to release our official 4Suites integration! You can now connect and control 4Suites locks to unlock doors and issue wallet passes.
articles.title: New Integration: 4Suites

articles.summary: The Seam TTLock integration is now live. This integration lets you connect any TTLock smart lock and use the Seam API and Dashboard to control these devices. Create access codes, remotely unlock them, read battery levels, and more.
articles.title: New Integration: TTLocks

articles.summary: Today we are announcing the release of our 2N intercom integration. This now lets you connect 2N intercoms and access systems to Seam and use our API + dashboard to control them. You can unlock doors, edit resident directory, and retrieve entry events. Most 2N intercom models come with a built in camera which we will release as part of our broader Universal Camera API later this summer.
articles.title: New Integration: 2N Intercoms

articles.summary: Despite strong demand from both hotels and guests, digital keys have struggled to achieve widespread adoption due to infrastructure fragmentation, engineering complexity, and guest friction. By addressing all three barriers at once, unified platforms like Seam aim to make digital access scalable, practical, and truly seamless for hospitality operators.
articles.title: Whatever Happened To Digital Keys?

articles.summary: Seam introduces new device capability flags, letting developers see exactly what IoT devices can do in real time, and making app development simpler and more accurate.
articles.title: New Capability Flags

articles.summary: We are releasing our NoiseAware sensor integration. You can now connect NoiseAware sensors to your Seam workspace and dashboard to receive elevated noise-level incidents.
articles.title: New Integration: NoiseAware

articles.summary: This week, we are super excited to release our official Igloohome integration! You can now connect and control all Igloohome locks, including the popular padlocks and keyboxes. We’re thrilled to be working with the Igloo team and see what you guys build with their devices.
articles.title: New Integration: Igloohome

articles.summary: This week we are excited to the beta launch of our Java SDK.
articles.title: New Seam Java SDK

articles.summary: Instant Key is a powerful new product that enables you to create and share mobile keys with a single API call.
articles.title: Announcing Seam Instant Keys

articles.summary: Seam is excited to release our official Dormakaba Oracode integration! You can now connect and control Dormakaba 480i and 660i locks to create access codes.
articles.title: New Integration: Dormakaba Oracode

articles.summary: New U.S. tariffs on imported smart home devices—some reaching up to 46%—are putting pressure on manufacturers, particularly those relying on Chinese or Vietnamese assembly, to either absorb costs or pass them on to consumers. While consumer demand may soften due to rising prices, enterprise and property management sectors are expected to remain resilient, sustaining overall growth in the smart home market.
articles.title: How U.S. Tariffs Impact Smart Home Device Manufacturers and Demand for Devices

articles.summary: This week we are excited to the beta launch of our Go SDK. You can now use Seam inside your Go-lang applications.
articles.title: Announcing our Seam Go SDK

articles.summary: We are excited to announce the official release of our Kwikset Halo locks integration. This integration allows you to connect any Kwikset Halo smart lock and use the Seam API and Dashboard to control the devices, create access codes to let people in, unlock the door, and receive events.
articles.title: New Integration: Kwikset Smart Locks

articles.summary: Today we’re thrilled to announce the release of our brand new Seam CLI client. This command line utility lets you control Seam resources (devices, workspaces, and more) directly inside your terminal. We’re also making the CLI available inside a web browser with a ready-to-go environment inside console.seam.co
articles.title: Introducing Seam CLI

articles.summary: This week, we are super excited to release our official Tedee integration! You can now connect and control all Tedee locks.
articles.title: New Integration: Tedee

articles.summary: Seam has launched a new API for integrating physical access control systems like Salto, Latch, and Assa Abloy, enabling developers to easily issue mobile keys, PIN codes, and plastic cards. The API simplifies complex integrations and comes with native iOS and Android SDKs, helping software and AI agents grant access across a growing list of supported systems.
articles.title: Meet Our New Access Control Systems API & SDK
